Flipping Research
CSV guide
Every Notion property the dashboard reads from your CSV. Required ones are mandatory; optional ones unlock additional widgets and filters.
No Notion journal yet? Download one of our templates to get started — the property names will match the list below automatically.
!
Property naming — read this first
Your Notion property names should match exactly the names below for automatic detection. Using a custom name? No problem — open the ▤Data button next to the Flipping Research logo, open the Mapping tab and hit the ✏ pencil next to the dimension you want to remap. The dashboard only cares about the data inside, not the column label.
Required properties 3 mandatory
Property Type Powers these widgets Description
Position Result Select
All widgets
 Trade outcome: Take profit, Stop loss, BE - TP, BE - SL. Rows missing this are skipped.
RR TP 1 Number
All R-based widgets
 Realized R on first take profit (e.g. 2.4 or -1). Feeds equity, expectancy, drawdown.
Date Date
All time-based widgets
 Trade date. Format: Month DD, YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD.
Important properties 5 strongly recommended
Property Type Powers these widgets Description
RR Max Number
Optimal RRPartial Optimizer
 Hypothetical peak R the trade could have reached if left open (also valid after closure). Drives the Partial Optimizer's full simulation engine — without this field, the Partial Optimizer cannot model partial-take strategies.
Notion URL Formula
Trade log link button
 Deep link to the Notion page (adds the 🔗 button on each trade row). In Notion, use a Formula property with this formula (click to copy):
H4 Before URL / File
Trade Log screenshotsSelection drawer
 H4 chart screenshot before entry. Same format as M15 Before. Surfaces as a 📷 button on each trade row.
M15 Before URL / File
Trade Log screenshotsSelection drawer
 M15 chart screenshot before entry. Accepts a Notion Files & media property or a plain URL. TradingView share URLs (/x/<ID>/) are auto-converted to S3 snapshot PNGs. Surfaces as a 📷 button on each trade row.
M15 After URL / File
Trade Log screenshotsSelection drawer
 M15 chart screenshot after the trade closes. Same format as M15 Before. Surfaces as a 📸 button on each trade row.
Optional properties 11 unlock more
Property Type Powers these widgets Description
Pair Select
Pair PerformancePair × Session
 Currency pair traded (e.g. EURUSD).
Position Type Multi-select
Backtest vs Live filter
 Trade classification: BackTest, Live, Invalid.
Day Select
Day PerformanceSession × Day Heatmap
 Day of week, full English name (Monday … Sunday).
Session Select
Session PerformanceSession × Day HeatmapPair × Session
 Trading session (e.g. London KZ, New York KZ).
Time Select
Hour Heatmap
 Entry hour: HHh format (e.g. 10h) or integer 0-23.
Order Select
Long / Short breakdown
 Trade direction: Buy (long) or Sell (short).
M15 Type Detailed Select
Setup Performance
 Setup family (e.g. Internal Continuation, Reversal).
M15 Obstacles Multi-select
M15 Obstacles
 M15 obstacle tags, comma-separated (e.g. Big Volume, Range Sweep).
H4 Obstacles Multi-select
H4 ObstaclesS3 Filter
 H4 obstacle tags, comma-separated. Powers the H4 No-Sweep filter.
Bad feeling Checkbox
Emotional filter
 Checkbox flag for emotion-marked trades. Lets you filter them out.
BE Management Multi-select
BE filter (sidebar)Optimal RR BE exclusion
 BE management tags, comma-separated (e.g. TP Direct, BE si set à 1RR, No BE available). Drives BE-aware classification and the BE Management filter.
Multi TP mode (advanced) 3 fields · no defaults
These fields are only required when the active TP Management mode is set to Multi TP. They have no canonical Notion name — wire your own Notion properties via the Mapping tab in the Data panel. A null value means that tier was not hit.
Property Type Powers these widgets Description
TP 1 realized R Number
Multi TP simulation
 Realized R at the first take-profit tier. null if TP1 was not hit.
TP 2 realized R Number
Multi TP simulation
 Realized R at the second take-profit tier. null if TP2 was not hit.
TP 3 realized R Number
Multi TP simulation (3-tier)
 Realized R at the third take-profit tier. Only required when Multi TP is configured for 3 tiers. null if TP3 was not hit.
